summary: Singles Game Night is one recurring activity of "Single and Social in Asheville," a Meetup-based social group for singles (skewing 30s-40s, open to all ages) with 2,542 members and 5 organizers. The group runs board-game nights at Archetype Brewing plus other recurring socials (New Belgium, Wicked Weed, whiskey nights, bonfires) for the same returning membership base, not a one-off commercial event. The MountainX unit itself is a templated "Every Monday at Archetype" listing that alternates between this singles group and an unrelated Brazilian roda music circle, so only the singles-game-night half of the alternation is this group.

evidence.note: Listing text explicitly says the singles game night is 'organized through a third party through Meetup', pointing at an external persistent group rather than a venue-run event.

All 12 listings share identical generic copy ('Every Monday at Archetype is packed with fun! It's either hosting Singles Game Night... or Brazilian Roda live music'), confirming this is a templated alternating-Monday slot, not evidence of the group itself.
Meetup group page: 2,542 members, 4.6-star rating over 256 reviews, 5 organizers including named super-organizer Andrew I., recurring game nights at Archetype plus other venues.
Independent listing for the same recurring game night, confirming it is a distinct, repeatedly-scheduled activity separate from the roda music nights.
